<!-- pr-reviewer: e76fec3fcb18dc3567848fe97c909883d95090f7 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- One rule, not a per-kind hand list. `crates/app/src/mcp/kind_fields/trace.rs` drives each kind's own `Deserialize` with a recording deserializer. A field a params struct gains is listed without a hand edit. The pinning test `list_operation_types_reads_every_kind_completely` fails on a kind the trace cannot read (`fields_incomplete`).
- A second small trace (`kind_fields/written.rs`) records the keys the value writes. A key the type reads but never writes (the legacy wire `start`) is not offered. The pinning test asserts this.
- The two `#[serde(flatten)]` kinds (thread, sinker_side_burn) are traced by hand-name, with the limit named in the body: a new optional key on the outer thread variant is the one case the test does not see.
- Placement: the code lives in `crates/app/src/mcp/`. It uses serde only, which is already a dependency. The test joins the existing `tests/mcp/` directory suite. The decision record is present.
- The body has `Changelog:`, `Fixes #3449`, a conventional subject and a `Effort: medium` line.

## Results merged with main

Trial merge: clean, no conflicts. PR base `baad348f` is an ancestor of fetched `origin/main` (`3bb6647f`). The worktree is at the PR head `e76fec3fc`. The PR touches no `.github/`, `build.rs`, `scripts/`, `.cargo/`, `xtask/` or `Cargo.toml`, so not "read, not built".

Built and tested locally in the worktree (`CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`, debug):

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp`: **52 passed, 0 failed**. This includes both pinning tests `list_operation_types_reads_every_kind_completely` and `list_operation_types_names_the_optional_fields_and_enum_words`.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_wire_contour --test mcp_compact --test break_through`: **28 passed, 0 failed** (9 + 7 + 12). This includes `mcp_wire_contour::list_operation_types_and_skill_match_wire_contour_dto_and_tool_law`, `mcp_wire_contour::list_operation_types_says_the_wire_kind_mounts_a_wire_tool`, `mcp_compact::list_operation_types_filters_by_kind_and_by_section` and `break_through::issue_2441_mcp_list_operation_types_lists_break_through`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib -- -D warnings`: clean (2m19s).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test mcp -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Full `--all-targets` clippy was not run locally. It builds all about 700 test binaries of `camcraft-app`, which is outside the review time box. The author's body records it clean.
- The UI suites that failed on the author's host (no display/adapter): `ui suites: lib`, `ui suites: egui_app` and `ui suites: shell` are green under `xvfb-run` on this host at this head. The peer session verified them: `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` 1667/0 failed, `--test egui_app` 8/0, `--test shell` 21/0. This PR changes no UI file. Not re-run here.
- The author's `cargo xtask gate quick` on the final head (1215 steps, 1212 pass, 3 fail) had the 3 UI failures; the peer's xvfb-run verification at the same head makes them green on this host.

## Targeted tests

- No post or toolpath change. No `example_catalog*` suites owed.
- P3 PR, no heavy lane reach. No heavy step owed.
- Light lane: the gate's build step (`release --no-run` of every motion and app test binary) did not fit the 10-minute cap, so each light step was run directly with the gate's own command line (`cargo test --release -j 6 ... --ignored <twin>`). All 11 light twins passed: motion lib (7: `the_pocket_face_is_cleared_inside_its_region_under_the_engagement_limit_light`, `the_opened_bore_leaves_no_post_at_the_lane_start_light`, `without_lift_room_the_returns_retract_and_a_plunge_entry_is_said_unread_light`, `explicit_trochoidal_parameters_control_engagement_return_feed_and_loop_width_light`, `custom_parameters_reach_parallel_and_closed_lane_layouts_light`, `custom_return_feed_is_emitted_by_production_parallel_lanes_and_cleanup_light`, `the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations_light`), adaptive_troch_island (1), adaptive_troch_neck (1), adaptive_troch_parallel (1), and app/pocket_pass_start (1: `fig8_pocket_outside_starts_each_level_at_the_stock_edge_light`). Green.

## Requested before merge

Nothing blocking.

## Notes (not blocking)

- Wire `condition` is required by the add_operation check, not by serde. The listing shows it with `"optional": true` and default `""`. An agent that reads the listing alone might omit it and be refused. The body honestly flags this; the listing could say "required" for it in a follow-up.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs` was already over 400 lines and gained 5 more. A future split would help.
- No units per field. Serde has no unit. The body says so.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
